SELECTED_INDEX: 6
CONFIDENCE: 0.66
EXPLANATION: The spectrum is dominated by a very strong band at 854 cm⁻¹ with a companion at 881 cm⁻¹, plus C–O rich features at ~1070–1090 and ~1230–1265 cm⁻¹. This pattern is characteristic of an epoxide (strong ring/COC modes ~850–900 and ~1250 cm⁻¹) together with C–O stretches of saturated ethers/alcohols. Candidate 6 uniquely contains an epoxide ring and hydroxyl groups, matching these bands. The CH-stretch region (2961/2997 cm⁻¹ with a weaker 3040 cm⁻¹) is consistent with strained/saturated C–H (GFQ-003). The weak 1647 cm⁻¹ band aligns with H-bonded O–H bending (GFQ-001), compatible with the diol in candidate 6. Other candidates lacking epoxide/OH (or bearing C=N/C=C or aromatics) are less consistent with the prominent 850–900 and ~1250 cm⁻¹ features and the overall saturated profile.
